source.license_review: Official license permits access, use, reproduction and modification only for non-commercial research. The complete dataset may not be redistributed. The verified local cache remains ignored.

intermediate_states.format: per-extrude SMT/STEP/OBJ references in ignored local cache

planned_subset.selection_rule: Future work only: official r1.0.1 train/test membership; final STEP present; one final solid after STEP read; timeline restricted to Sketch and ExtrudeFeature; only NewBodyFeatureOperation, JoinFeatureOperation or CutFeatureOperation; centimetres converted to millimetres before local replay.
planned_subset.family_or_source_split_rule: Preserve the official train/test split; do not derive both splits from one design family.
planned_subset.stopping_condition: M14-001 fixed source SHA-256 and a 2 development/1 held-out subset, and proved replay and existing gates. M16-001 completed path/hash/split re-audit and separate local-only manifests. M17-001 stopped at its preregistered bound after a held-out mismatch; M17-002 rejected endpoint ordering; and M17-003 rejected coordinate-frame/extrude-direction mapping after its held-out candidate regressed Line3D controls. M17-004 nominated a profile-normal / STEP-projection / extent-boundary selector; M17-005 passed its fixed four-case matrix and M17-006 passed a preregistered independent 2 development/1 held-out matrix while strict replay remained default. Existing gates remain fixed.

runtime_boundary.notes: M13-001 completed the ignored local archive/cache: SHA-256 485601de3d23e25a5d63a75588ca780fa7881d7a0bea1ab6c24dbcefa57ad5c9, ZIP CRC and safe extraction passed. M14-001 then established local replay evidence for three selected cases. M16-001 completed separate local-only manifests. M17-004 nominated a selector; M17-005 passed its fixed four-case treatment matrix and M17-006 passed a preregistered independent 2 development/1 held-out matrix without changing strict default replay.
